title: Stromledge.
author: AstroBadr
selftext:
Hello folks,

With my co-founders, we're building a tool that lets traders generate trading algorithms without having to learn to code them themselves. We would love to hear lot of feedback about the platform and know exactly and what can change. Please feel free try it and don't hesitate to reach out for feedback.

Please comment and I will send you the link for it.

replies.author: Capable_Tale750
replies.body:
On the security side, your email auth stack is solid. DMARC set to reject with reporting, SPF is tight through Cloudflare, and you are not leaking a bunch of forgotten dev subdomains. I checked for admin, staging, dev, test, api, all the usual suspects, all good there. Also you have zero third party trackers on the marketing page, no Google Analytics, which is great. 

Biggest issue I see is you have zero content security policy header. You are missing a couple of headers. No X Content Type Options nosniff, and no frame ancestors or X Frame Options, which means your site can be iframed by anyone. Clickjacking risk on a static page is low but it is a two minute fix and you want it locked down before the app does anything interactive. The strategy examples are a mixed bag. MACD with ATR trail, support and resistance, breakout, mean reversion, vol targeting, all legit. But you have smart money concepts, fair value gap, order block as example number three, and SMC has basically no statistical backing. Here is the thing. You cannot simultaneously sell we will tell you honestly if your edge is real AND feature order block strategies as a flagship example without a footnote acknowledging that spoiler this one usually does not pass the test.

A couple of other things- there are no founder names anywhere on the site, no about page, no linkedin links. For a tool that will eventually ask traders to trust AI generated code with their strategies, anonymity is a conversion killer. Your Reddit post says with my co founders, so put faces on the site. No harm done if you want to be taken seriously.

Research grade data is asserted with no sourcing. A trader will immediately ask whose data, Polygon, FirstRate, Tick Data, name it or drop the adjective. Also double check your default commission assumptions. 5 bps is high for FX and low for equities, and if your backtest defaults are not realistic per instrument you will get roasted. 

I can definitely help more once you shoot over the invite code but that's all I got for now.
